SETTING: Plain unmarked old Chinese house doorway and swept earthen threshold, dark tree line behind fleeing tiger. The bird is alive, not a statue or door carving. [wd-q11410474-c03, wd-q11410474-c05]
MOOD: Fierce awe-inspiring protective guardian, imposing dangerous confrontation, never cute, comic, cheerful, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: Native square PNG minimum1024. No text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, wings, legs, beaks or pupils; EXACTLY TWO eyes each containing TWO pupils. No rounded comic chicken face, bulging eyes, gaping smile or open goofy beak. Do not substitute eagle or phoenix anatomy; keep chicken-like head/body/legs. No borrowed film, game, anime or comic design. No nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
